## Join Proposal

**Branch:** `topic/join-<team-name>` (e.g.,
`topic/join-cosmology-wg`)

**Compare URL:**
```
https://github.com/QSSLibrary/Team/compare/topic/join-<team-name>?template=join-proposal.md
```

**Source content template:** `templates/join-proposal.md`
(use this for the proposal body)

---

- Hours per week:

## Disclosure (optional)

Any conflicts of interest, time constraints, or
other context the lead should be aware of.

## For the team lead

The lead should review this proposal per
`governance/working-groups.md` §9 and respond with:

- [ ] Accept
- [ ] Decline (with reason)
- [ ] Defer (with reason)
- [ ] Ask for more info

On accept, the lead should:
- [ ] Add to GitHub team
- [ ] Add to Discord role (if applicable)
- [ ] Send welcome message
- [ ] Suggest a first task / issue
- [ ] Add to the team's GitHub Project entry
- [ ] Introduce to the team in the team's
      Discord channel

---

**Note:** Working-group membership rules are in
`governance/working-groups.md` §9. Research-group
membership rules are in IRC-ATL's governance
(forthcoming).
